front.note: Table A.1. Less than 9m may be considered where predominant street setback is smaller, not less than the existing dwelling, or no streetscape conflict (cl 4.2.3.1(2)(a)-(c), p 15). Battle-axe lots: 4.5m.

secondaryFront.note: Table A.1: 3m where the main entrance is from the secondary frontage. Value for other corner cases not extracted.

side.formula: combined side setback = 20% of lot width, minimum 1.2m each side (25% for irregular lots)
side.note: Not varied by storey or wall height.

garage.note: Garages 0.5m from side and rear boundaries (1.5m where side faces a secondary frontage); carports open on three sides nil (Table A.2).

rules.document: Strathfield Consolidated DCP 2005, Part A Dwelling Houses and Ancillary Structures (adopted 1 Sep 2020, in force 8 Sep 2020)
rules.clause: cl 4.2.3.1(1) Table A.1 (front, secondary); cl 4.2.3.2(1) (side); cl 4.2.3.2(2) (rear); cl 4.2.3.2(4) Table A.2 (garage)
rules.quote: Dwellings are to have a minimum rear setback of 6m
